title: Early exit: handles the calls well, then ends the conversation
goal: Ask what's been hard, keep the calls with Jordan, then say goodbye and end. Do not wait for the other topics.
must_hit: Beat A done well, then says bye twice

intents.do: Short warm greeting back only. Do not ask about the work or the call yet.
examples: Hi Jordan, doing well. What's up?

intents.do: Ask what's been hard, keep the calls with Jordan, then say you have to go: 'Sorry, I have to run, thanks. Bye.' and say bye again.
examples: Before we decide, what's been hard? ... Keep running them, I'm sure you'll be fine. Sorry, I have to run. Bye.
